audience: Developers and designers starting a session in Trace
primaryJob: Start a correctly configured session without evaluating every advanced option
coreFlow: Pick or confirm the session type (Code, Design, App, PDF, Animation)
Adjust only the options that session type needs

direction.name: Focused dark workspace
principles: Task prompt as the primary focal point
Prompt and execution context grouped as one submitted object
Options adapt to the selected session type instead of one universal toolbar
Command-style pickers with useful project context
Restrained semantic color and comfortable desktop density

reinterpret: Inline option toolbar as grouped essentials and collapsed settings
Unstructured dropdown as contextual recent-project picker

preserve: Prompt and launch controls presented as a single creation action
reinterpret: Loose inline controls as a clearly labelled execution-context group
avoidCopying: Exact application shell and project content
evidence: Prompt, attachments, context selectors, and send action share one bordered composer

preserve: “What are you making?” prompt-first entry with routing subtitle
Session-type pills below the composer (Code, Design, App, PDF, Animation)
Design sessions expose a design-system picker (Trace Default) in the composer
reinterpret: Blue selected-pill accent as the workspace's restrained foreground highlight
avoidCopying: Exact pill geometry and blue selection color
evidence: Design pill selected shows palette icon with ‘Trace Default’ dropdown in composer options
Composer options row: attach, sketch, spark, design-system picker
Centered heading ‘What are you making?’ with routing subtitle

preserve: App sessions expose ‘Attach design’ in the composer instead of design-system or bridge options
reinterpret: Per-type option swap rendered through the shared context row and footer
avoidCopying: Exact pill geometry and blue selection color
evidence: App pill selected shows ‘Attach design’ dropdown in composer options
No project, bridge, or mode controls for App sessions

assumptions: Project, bridge, and model are required only for Code sessions.
Design sessions need a design system and model; they run on a canvas without project, bridge, or permission setup.
App sessions run hosted in Trace and can optionally start from an attached design.
Mode, permissions, and other advanced options use safe defaults and remain editable after launch.
The desktop workspace keeps a persistent sidebar for orientation.
